create_Vocab_with_special_tokens: create a Vocab instance initialized with special tokens like PAD, UNK, CLS, SEP, and MASK
create_Vocab_empty: create an empty Vocab instance with no preloaded special tokens for custom vocabulary building
add_words_to_Vocab: add a list of words to the Vocab, skipping duplicates and assigning new indices
review_Vocab_stoi_mapping: review the Vocab stoi dictionary to inspect string to index token mappings
summarize_Vocab_itos_list: summarize the Vocab itos list to see all tokens in index order
